stories.title: 첫 솔로 여행! 나 홀로 뉴욕
stories.subtitle: 낯선 뉴욕에서 혼자 영어로 부딪히기

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Hello, how can I help you today?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I want to book flights to New York.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Sure! What dates are you planning?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: June 15th to 22nd. It's my first solo trip.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Hello! Do you need travel insurance today?
scripts.translated: 안녕하세요! 오늘 여행자 보험 가입하러 오셨나요?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Yes, I'm going to New York.
scripts.hint: '~에 가려고요'는 I'm going to로 표현해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: When will you travel?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Next week. It's my first solo trip.
scripts.translated: 다음 주요. 혼자 여행하는 건 처음이에요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Hi! Do you need any help?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Yes, the kiosk shows an error.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: What happened?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: It stopped at the seat selection screen.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Are you going to New York alone?

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Yes, I am. You too?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Yes! It's my first solo trip.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Me too! I'm a little nervous.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Would you like something to drink?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: What do you have?
scripts.hint: '~가 있어요?'는 have를 사용한 의문문으로 표현해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: We have water, juice, coffee, and soda.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Do you have ginger ale?
scripts.hint: Do you have로 시작하여 '~있어요?'라는 질문을 완성하세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Hello! How can I help you today?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I need a SIM card, please.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Sure! How long will you stay?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: About one week in New York.
scripts.hint: '~정도'라는 의미를 나타낼 때 About으로 문장을 시작해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: How can I help you today?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: My room key isn't working.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Oh, I'm sorry about that. Which room?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Room 512. The light stays red.
scripts.hint: '계속 ~인 상태다'라는 의미로 stays red라는 표현을 사용해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Hello! Can I help you?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Yes, please. I need a subway ticket.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Sure. How long are you visiting?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I'm here for seven days.
scripts.hint: '~일 동안'처럼 기간을 나타낼 때 for를 사용하세요.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Excuse me. Can you help me?
scripts.hint: '저기요'는 누군가의 주의를 끌 때 쓰는 Excuse me로 표현하세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Sure! What do you need?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Can you take my photo, please?

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Of course! Where do you want it?

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Hello! How can I help you today?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I need information about tourist passes.
scripts.hint: '~을 알고 싶다'는 need information으로 표현해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: We have CityPass and Explorer Pass.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: What benefits do they have?

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Hello! How can I help you today?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I need one adult ticket, please.
scripts.hint: '주세요'를 I need를 사용해서 요청 문장으로 만들어 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Sure. That's twenty-five dollars.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Are there any free days?

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Front desk. How can I help you?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Hi, I need a wake-up call.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Of course. What time would you like?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Tomorrow at 7 AM, please.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Where to tonight?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: The Minskoff Theatre, please. Quickly!

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Got it. Broadway show?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Yes, Lion King at eight.
scripts.hint: 시간 '~시에'는 at eight처럼 at을 사용하여 표현하세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Hi! What can I get for you today?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I'd like one ShackBurger, please.
scripts.hint: '~주세요'를 정중하게 표현하려면 I'd like로 문장을 시작해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Sure! Anything else with that?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Yes, fries and a vanilla shake.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Hello! How can I help you?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I have a reservation for Lion King.
scripts.hint: '예약했어요'는 have a reservation이라는 표현을 사용해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Great! Can I see your confirmation?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Here's my email confirmation.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Hi! What can I get you today?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: What's your signature drink here?
scripts.hint: 가게의 것을 물을 때는 What's your...?라는 표현을 사용해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Our New Orleans iced coffee is popular.
scripts.translated: 뉴 올리언스 아이스 커피가 인기 있어요.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Sounds good. What's in it?

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Is everything okay with your coffee?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Yes, it's good. Do you have WiFi here?
scripts.hint: '~이 되나요?'라고 물을 때는 Do you have라는 표현을 사용해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Yes, we do. It's free for customers.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Great! What's the password?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Excuse me, can you help me?

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Sure, what's wrong?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I took the express by mistake.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Where are you going?

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Hello! Can I help you?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Yes, I have a sore throat.
scripts.hint: '목이 아프다'는 sore throat라는 표현을 사용해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Do you have other symptoms?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I have a slight fever too.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Hi! How can I help you?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I want to send this postcard.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Where are you sending it to?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: To my family. They live overseas.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Hi! Are you James?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Yes, that's me. Hi!

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Going to the Hilton Hotel, right?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Yes, the one in Manhattan.
scripts.hint: '~에 있는 것'이라는 의미로 the one을 사용하세요.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I'm back from New York!

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: How was traveling alone?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Amazing! Solo travel is great!
scripts.translated: 대박! 혼자 여행하는 거 진짜 좋더라!
scripts.hint: '혼자 여행하는 거'는 solo travel이라는 표현으로 간결하게 나타낼 수 있어요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: What did you do there?

stories.title: 스티브 잡스: 다르게 생각하라
stories.subtitle: 차고에서 시작해 세상을 바꾼 혁신가의 이야기

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Look at this! It connects to a monitor!

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Wow! Did you build this yourself?

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Yes. I worked on it for months.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: This is really cool. Show me more.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Look at this board. It's a real computer.
scripts.hint: '~을 좀 보세요'는 Look at으로 시작하여 표현해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Interesting. What can it do?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: It runs programs. It's easy to use.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: I like it. I'll order fifty units.

topics.title: 외상 거래의 기술
topics.partner: 전자부품 가게 점원 해럴드 모리슨 (직원, 남성, 40대)

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Good afternoon. How can I help you?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I need electronic parts for a project.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Sure. What do you need?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Here is my list. But I have no cash.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Thank you for meeting me today.
scripts.hint: '시간 내 주셔서'는 for meeting me로 표현해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Sure. Tell me about your computer project.
scripts.translated: 그럼요. 컴퓨터 프로젝트에 대해 얘기해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: We want to put a computer in every home.
scripts.translated: 저희는 모든 가정에 컴퓨터를 보급하려고 합니다.
scripts.hint: '~에 보급하다'는 put ~ in으로, '모든 가정'은 every home으로 표현해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Every home? How big is the market?
scripts.translated: 모든 가정이요? 시장 규모가 어느 정도죠?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: The investment is done. We need a name.
scripts.translated: 투자는 끝났어. 이제 이름을 정해야 해.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Yes, we do. Any ideas?
scripts.translated: 그러게. 뭐 생각해 둔 거 있어?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: How about "Apple Computer"?

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Apple? Why an apple? It's strange.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Welcome to my studio. How can I help?
scripts.translated: 스튜디오에 오신 걸 환영해요. 뭘 도와드릴까요?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I need a logo for my company.
scripts.hint: '회사를 위한'이라는 의미로 for my company를 사용하세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Sure. What kind of design do you want?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: An apple. But with a bite taken out.
scripts.translated: 사과요. 근데 한 입 베어문 느낌으로요.
scripts.hint: '한 입 베어문'은 a bite taken out으로 표현해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Welcome to the Apple booth!
scripts.hint: '~에 오신 걸 환영합니다'는 Welcome to로 표현하세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Thanks! Is this a personal computer?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Yes, this is the Apple II.
scripts.hint: 특정 제품을 가리킬 때는 정관사 the를 붙여 the Apple II로 표현하세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Is it a finished product?

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Hello! Who are you? You look young.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I'm Steve Jobs. I'm twenty-two years old.
scripts.hint: 나이를 말할 때 '~살이에요'는 years old로 표현하세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Twenty-two? And you have your own booth?
scripts.translated: 스물두 살이요? 그런데 직접 부스를 운영하시는 건가요?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Yes. My company is called Apple.
scripts.hint: '이름은 ~이에요'라는 표현을 is called로 바꿔서 문장을 만들어 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Welcome to Xerox PARC. I'll show you our work.
scripts.translated: 제록스 파크에 오신 걸 환영합니다. 저희 작업물을 보여드릴게요.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Thank you. What will you show me?
scripts.hint: '뭘 ~할 건가요?'라는 질문은 What will you로 시작해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: This is a new way to use computers.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: What is that small box there?
scripts.hint: '저기 저'는 that과 there를 함께 사용하여 표현하세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Steve, the board made a decision today.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: What decision? Tell me.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: They decided to remove you from management.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Remove me? I built this company!

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: So, here we are. Our new beginning.
scripts.translated: 자, 드디어 여기까지 왔군. 우리의 새로운 시작이야.
scripts.hint: '드디어 여기까지 왔군'은 here we are라는 표현으로 나타낼 수 있어요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Yes, but Apple filed a lawsuit.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I expected that. They kicked me out.
scripts.translated: 예상했어. 날 쫓아낸 게 그 사람들인데.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Will we be okay?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: What is your dream for this team?
scripts.hint: '이 팀을 위한'이라는 의미로 for this team을 사용해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: We want to make 3D animated movies.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Movies made by computers?

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Yes. Computers can create new worlds.
scripts.translated: 네. 컴퓨터로 새로운 세계를 창조할 수 있어요.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: You wanted to see me. What's this about?

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Apple wants to buy NeXT.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Just my company? Or something more?

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: I need your help too. Please come back.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: I have a new idea for Apple.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Great. What is the idea?
scripts.hint: '아이디어'는 the idea로 표현하여 질문을 완성해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: The campaign is called 'Think Different.'

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Think Different? I like that name.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: What about a translucent plastic case?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: That's revolutionary! I love it.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: It will look friendly and modern.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Make it all-in-one. Use only USB ports.
scripts.hint: '~으로 하다'는 Make it으로 표현하고, '~만'은 only로 표현해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: I have an idea for a music player.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Tell me about it.
scripts.hint: '~에 대해'라는 의미의 about it을 활용해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: It uses a small hard drive inside.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: How many songs can it store?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Is the team ready?
scripts.hint: '준비 됐어?'라고 물을 때 Is... ready?라는 구조를 사용하세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Yes. Everything is ready.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Good. Let me practice one more time.
scripts.hint: '~해볼게'라는 의미를 Let me로 시작하여 표현해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Of course. I'm listening.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: The iPad design is finally complete.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Let me see it.
scripts.hint: '~해 보자'라는 표현은 Let me로 시작해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Here it is. Very thin and light.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Perfect. Not a PC or a phone.
scripts.hint: '~도 ~도 아니야'는 영어로 Not... or... 구조를 사용해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Come in. Please sit down.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Of course. Is something wrong?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I have to tell you something.
scripts.hint: '할 말이 있다'는 have to tell이라는 표현을 사용해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: I'm listening.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: It's me. Tomorrow is the big day.
scripts.hint: '중요한 날'은 the big day라는 표현으로 나타내 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Yes, we're almost ready here.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Please emphasize Siri. It's very important.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Siri will be the main demo.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: It's getting harder to breathe now.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: I'm right here. I love you.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: You and the kids are my best work.
scripts.hint: '최고의 작품'은 my best work로 표현해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: You changed the whole world.

stories.title: 투자의 달인 도전기
stories.subtitle: 꿈에 그린 경제적 자유를 향한 여정

topics.title: 은행 예금만으로는 자산을 불릴 수 없다는 것을 깨닫기

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: How can I help you today?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I want to grow my money.
scripts.hint: '돈을 불리다'는 grow라는 동사를 사용해 표현해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: What are you doing now?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I only have a savings account.

topics.title: 주식 투자로 돈을 번 친구의 이야기를 듣고 자극받기

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Hey, you look really happy today.
scripts.translated: 야, 너 오늘 진짜 기분 좋아 보인다.
scripts.hint: '~해 보인다'는 look + 형용사 구조로, look happy라고 표현해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: I made good money from stocks!

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Really? How much did you make?

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: I made three thousand dollars last month.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I think we should study investing together.
scripts.translated: 우리 같이 투자 공부 해야 할 것 같아.
scripts.hint: '~해야 할 것 같아'는 I think ~ should 구문을 사용해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: That's a good idea. But investing is risky.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Yes, I know. We need to learn first.
scripts.translated: 응, 알아. 우린 먼저 배워야 해.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: What should we study? There's so much information.
scripts.translated: 뭘 공부해야 할까? 정보가 너무 많아.

topics.title: 열심히 모은 종잣돈으로 무엇을 할지 의논하기

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I saved some money to invest.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: That's great! How much did you save?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: About three thousand dollars. Where should I invest?
scripts.translated: 한 삼천 달러 정도. 어디에 투자하면 좋을까?

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: I'm putting mine in technology stocks.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Hello! How can I help you today?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I want to open an account here.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Sure! What will you use it for?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I want to start investing in stocks.

topics.title: 첫 주식을 매수하고 계속 주가 확인하기

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I bought my first stock today!

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: That's exciting! Which company?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Apple. I keep checking the price.
scripts.hint: '자꾸 ~하게 돼'는 keep checking이라는 표현으로 나타낼 수 있어요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: How often are you checking?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: My stocks keep going down badly.
scripts.translated: 제 주식이 계속 많이 빠지고 있어요.
scripts.hint: '계속 빠지고 있다'는 keep going down으로 표현해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: How long have you had them?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I bought them two months ago.
scripts.hint: '~전에'는 ago를 사용하여 two months ago로 표현하세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Which companies did you buy?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Look! I got my first dividend!
scripts.translated: 자기야 봐! 나 첫 배당금 받았어!

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Really? That's great news!

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Yes, the company sent it today.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Money without working. That's nice!
scripts.translated: 일 안 하고 버는 돈이네. 좋다!

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I lost all our savings today.
scripts.translated: 오늘 우리 저축한 돈 다 잃었어.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: What? How did that happen?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I invested in stocks yesterday.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Which stocks? Why didn't you tell me?
scripts.translated: 무슨 주식? 왜 나한테 말 안 했어?

topics.title: 투자 실패 원인을 분석하고 교훈 얻기

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: So, tell me about your investment problem.
scripts.translated: 그래서, 투자 문제에 대해 말해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I lost a lot of money recently.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: What happened? Which investment was it?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I bought stocks when prices were high.
scripts.hint: '~할 때'는 when으로 연결하고, '높았다'는 were high로 표현하세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Hello! How can I help you today?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I want to invest my money.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Great! How much do you want to invest?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: About fifty thousand dollars.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: What do you think about investing?
scripts.hint: '~에 대해 생각하다'는 think about으로, '투자'는 investing으로 표현하세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: I prefer long-term investment strategies.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Why is long-term better?

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Short-term trading is too risky.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I need some investment rules.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Good idea! Why now?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I always change my mind.
scripts.hint: '마음이 바뀌다'는 change와 mind를 활용해 표현해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: What kind of rules?

topics.title: 경제 뉴스를 꾸준히 챙겨보는 습관 만들기

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Hey, I want to read economic news daily.
scripts.translated: 야, 나 경제 뉴스 매일 챙겨보고 싶은데.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: That's a good idea! When will you read?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Maybe during lunch time. We can read together.
scripts.hint: '점심시간에'를 표현할 때 during이라는 전치사를 사용해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Sure! We can discuss the news too.
scripts.translated: 좋아! 뉴스 얘기도 나눌 수 있고.

topics.title: 투자로 월급보다 많은 돈을 처음 벌었을 때

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Honey, I have great news!
scripts.hint: '소식이 있어'를 표현할 때 I have로 시작해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: What is it? You look excited!

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: My investment made more than my salary!
scripts.hint: '~보다 많았어'는 made more than으로 표현해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Really? That's amazing! How much did you make?

topics.title: 부동산 투자를 위해 현장 답사 가기

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Hello! Ready to see some properties today?
scripts.translated: 안녕하세요! 오늘 매물 보러 갈 준비 되셨어요?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Yes, I want to invest here.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Great. This area is growing fast.
scripts.translated: 좋아요. 이 지역은 빠르게 성장하고 있어요.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: How fast is it growing?
scripts.hint: How fast로 시작하여 현재진행형 의문문을 만들어 보세요.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: We did it! Our first property!

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: I can't believe this is happening.
scripts.translated: 이게 진짜 일어나고 있다니 믿기지 않아.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: All those months of saving worked.
scripts.hint: '~한 보람이 있다'는 worked라는 동사로 표현해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: And that smart investment really helped us.
scripts.translated: 그리고 그 똑똑한 투자가 정말 도움이 됐지.

topics.title: 경제적 자유를 달성한 기분에 대해 이야기하기

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Guess what? I'm finally financially free!
scripts.translated: 야, 있잖아. 나 드디어 경제적 자유 달성했어!
scripts.hint: '야, 있잖아'는 Guess what?으로 표현할 수 있어요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Really? That's amazing news!

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I don't worry about money anymore.
scripts.translated: 이제 돈 걱정 안 해도 돼.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: How did you do it?

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Do you have time for coffee?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Sure! What do you want to discuss?
scripts.hint: '~하고 싶어?'의 의미로 want to를 사용하고, '얘기하다'는 discuss로 표현해 보세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: I want to start investing my money.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: That's great! How much can you invest?
scripts.translated: 좋은 생각이네! 얼마나 투자할 수 있는데?

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Hello! How can I help you today?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I want to donate money regularly.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: That's wonderful! How much each month?
scripts.translated: 정말 좋으시네요! 한 달에 얼마 정도요?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I can give $500 every month.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I want to retire early.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Really? When do you want to?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: Maybe in five years.
scripts.hint: '~후'라는 시간 표현은 전치사 in을 사용하여 in five years처럼 표현하세요.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: That's soon. Do we have enough?
scripts.translated: 얼마 안 남았네. 우리 돈 충분해?

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: Thank you for meeting me today.

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: It's my pleasure to be here.

scripts.speaker: B
scripts.english: What is your main investment philosophy?

scripts.speaker: A
scripts.english: I always think about the long term.
